reference_arms: A original LiuQP objective + certified executor; B new control scheme + same executor
definition: Original final-goal LiuQP without any added objective hook, terminal IK, posture, escape or memory policy; original pilot_worker baseline single-step execution, measured solve delay and original ExecutionGuard. Numerical solver profile deliberately identical to A/B.
not_claimed: Unmodified historical default OSQP settings; solver numerics are controlled to isolate execution layer.
input_rule: Exact same 300 inputs and models by SHA-256, in original seed-major matrix order

budgets.includes: imports, model setup, solve, execution, logging and finalization

execution_delay: Original worker maps measured solve time only to command delay and retains prior command; original physical/braking ExecutionGuard stays unchanged. Guard cost remains included in full wall time. A executor additionally charges block certification to simulation waits; this scheduling difference is part of the execution-layer contrast.
preflight: 15 seed1 tasks: original QP matrices and initial velocity equivalence; identical original/adapted single-step trajectory under predeclared fixed delay sequence. Interface gate does not require successful arrival or discard ordinary failures.
audit: Same physical auditor, actual executed original QP row check and final feasible braking/rest property. C has no runtime backup certificate: deterministic original braking tail reconstructed and audited after execution only; never used by controller. Memory checks not exercised, no memory invented.
statistics: 300 C attempts all retained; report C->A executor gains/regressions, A->B control gains/regressions, C->B combined; raw arrival, physical-safe arrival and full strict arrival separately.
timing_scope: Same host, 12 workers x 4 cores and 4 audit workers x 4 cores. C is a later batch; measured-delay/load effects prevent claiming perfectly simultaneous causal timing control. Full costs and common-success paired differences reported.
